posts.author: The Decoder
posts.text: Anthropic says it cut Claude reasoning token theft by up to 99% in fight against industrial-scale distillation. Anthropic says it has cut the extraction of Claude's internal reasoning tokens by 90 to 99 percent. The company links the large-scale distillation attacks to Chinese companies Zhipu and Moonshot, and has already banned tens of thousands of accounts. The article Anthropic says it cut Claude reasoning token theft by up to 99% in fight against industrial-scale distillation appeared first on The Decoder .

posts.author: mark_k
posts.text:
Anthropic says it has cut the Claude reasoning harvested by rival model developers by 90% to 99%.

The target is distillation: collecting a stronger model's responses to train another model.

posts.text: Meta releases its first frontier model, Muse Wonder. Where Muse Spark aimed to be a lightweight model that could perform at low latency, the Wonder models are larger and said to be more capable, with higher benchmark scores and better results on complex tasks like coding.

posts.text: Meta's new frontier model Muse Wonder Full breaks into the AI top tier.
